commits.author: urigon
commits.message:
Upgraded spring boot from 1.5.8.RELEASE to 3.2.0

Also upgraded:
 * jdk 8 to 18
 * maven 3.5.2 to 3.8.7
 * docker compose file version 3
 * authlete-java-jaxrs:2.6 to authlete-java-jakarta:2.68
 * authlete-java-common 2.11 to 3.82 which is depended by authlete-java-jaxrs

NOTES:
 * src/main/resources/application.yml is added to set `spring.mvc.hiddenmethod.filter.enabled` to true.
   Setting the filter is requred since AuthorizationDecisionEndpoint#post no longer gets post parameters.
   See: https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/wiki/Spring-Boot-2.2-Release-Notes#httphiddenmethodfilter-disabled-by-default

 * The Freemarker template is renamed from authorization.ftl to authorization.ftlh that is changed to default file extension.
   See: https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/wiki/Spring-Boot-2.2-Release-Notes#freemarker-templates-configuration
